data.name: GCR1 Geoff Crammond
data.detailed_description:
Geoff Crammond Racing 1 (GCR1)

Geoff Crammond Racing 1 is where it all began—an authentic revival of the original classic that laid the foundation for the racing simulation genre. First released in the early 1990s, this legendary racing returns, retaining the pure spirit of the groundbreaking original.

GCR1 delivers the raw, unforgiving racing experience of the early 90s, featuring 16 international circuits inspired by real-world locations and a full grid of open-wheel machines, each recreated with meticulous attention to the original design and driving model.

Features:

  • The Original Racing Sim – Faithful to Geoff Crammond’s seminal work.

  • Deep Driving Model – Experience the physics, handling, and thrill of racing from the golden age of motorsport simulations.

  • Complete Season Mode – Compete in a full championship, managing race strategies, car setups, and rivalries.

  • Race Weekend Format – Practice, qualifying, and full-length races for every event on the calendar.

  • Track & Driver Customization – All tracks and drivers use fictional names by default, but can be renamed to your liking. Create your own drivers, teams, liveries, and track names.

  • Classic Replay System – Review your best laps and races with built-in replay and analysis tools.

  • Beginner-Friendly Options – Optional driving assists make it accessible for newcomers, while still challenging for veterans.

  • Dynamic Weather Conditions: Adapt your racing strategy to changing weather conditions. Rain can turn a dry track into a slippery challenge, testing your skills and decision-making on the fly.

  • In-Depth Car Customization: Fine-tune your vehicle's performance with various settings, including tire selection, fuel load, and suspension adjustments. Tailor your car to suit your driving style and the demands of each track.

  • Challenging AI Opponents: Compete against a field of intelligent AI drivers, each with its own racing styles and strategies. Can you outsmart them and claim the championship?

  • Multiple Game Modes: Choose from various game modes, including single races, full seasons, and time trials. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore racing fan, there's something for everyone.

  • Classic Graphics and Sound: Relive the nostalgia of early '90s gaming with charming pixel art graphics and an iconic soundtrack that captures the era's essence.

  • Realistic Racing Simulation: The game offers a highly detailed simulation of Formula One racing, including realistic physics and car handling.

  • Track Variety: Players can race on a variety of real-world tracks.

  • Pit Stops: Players must manage pit stops for tire changes, adding a strategic element to the races.

  • Keyboard and Joystick Support: Players can control their cars using a keyboard or joystick, allowing for flexible gameplay options.

Geoff Crammond Racing 1 (GCR1) captures the roots of racing simulation and brings it to a new generation. Whether you're reliving the past or discovering the origins of sim racing for the first time, MicroProse’s Geoff Crammond Racing 1 is a piece of gaming history.

Relive the unforgiving racing of the early ’90s with authentic physics, full race weekends, and a complete championship across 16 circuits. Customize drivers, teams, and tracks to shape your own racing legacy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce GTX 1070 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
